0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>An especially fatherly looking Mord needs your help to solve an unusual quandary.

25.original: Speak with the paternal Mord again.

27.original: Deliver the twinkling gemstone to the Mord youngling.

48.original: It is a dire emergency! Dire indeed! You must help!

49.original: Follow me, I will explain everything!

51.original: My most prized possession... I am lost without it!

53.original: My son was playing with his favorite gemstone and somehow it ended up on that balcony up there. I told him “If it is so precious, you should stop throwing it around like that,” but alas, my words fell on deaf ears!

54.original: It looked so pretty, spinning through the air! Oh, how it sparkled!

55.original: Enough of that, you fool! Ahem. As you can see, it is too high for any of us Mord to reach. We are simply not built for such acrobatics!

56.original: I have a feeling you would fare better. This way, please!

57.original: My poor boy... What did he do to deserve such awful luck?

58.original: I would do anything to get my gemstone, but Mother says, “No jumping off of cliffs!”

59.original: With your strong legs, you should be able to reach the roof by jumping from that plank over there.

60.original: Though the endeavor may be fraught with peril, you must get my son's gemstone back, or I shall never hear the end of it!

61.original: You might need a burst of speed first, although there is much room on that plank. Do whatever it takes!

62.original: The gemstone! Quickly, take it to my son before he suffers any longer!

63.original: You have the stone? Please, I beg you, give it to my boy!

65.original: Ah! I thought I would never see it again! I am so happy!

66.original: Father gave this to me. See how it shines!

67.original: I wanted to see it twinkling from above, like a star!

68.original: But if you want to see stars, you need only look to the night sky.

69.original: Even so, you must not throw it!

70.original: ...Yes, Mother. You are right. This is <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> star! I shall keep it with me, always.

71.original: Though we may never be able to repay your kindness, honorable stranger, please accept this as a token of our gratitude!
